Summarize ABGD Partitions and Plot Group Counts

abgd_summary.Rd

Summarize ABGD Partitions and Plot Group Counts

Usage

abgd_summary(output_folder, silent = F, text.partition.size = 3.4)

Arguments

output_folder

Character. Path to the ABGD output folder.

silent

Logical. If FALSE, prints the summary plot. Default is FALSE.

text.partition.size

Numeric. Text size for prior divergence labels above points. Default is 3.4.

Value

A named list of length 2:

plot

A ggplot object showing initial and recursive group counts across partitions.

summary

A data.frame summarizing index, initial, recursive, fine_group, fine_group_prop, and prior intraspecific divergence.

See also

abgd_execute(), abgd_read_result(), abgd_read_result_all(), abgd_delim()

Other abgd: abgd_delim(), abgd_disthist(), abgd_execute(), abgd_read_result(), abgd_read_result_all()
